title: ArchiveLens: A Generative Spatial Knowledge Framework for Semantic Reconstruction of Historical Maps
abstract: arXiv:2610.35606v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historical maps contain dense morphological and semantic information about past urban environments, but many digitization workflows focus primarily on extracting geometry, and do not capture cartographic semantics such as building use and construction materials. This study introduces ArchiveLens, a generative spatial knowledge framework that operationalizes historical maps as entity-centric, machine-queryable geospatial databases. The pipeline decouples morphological and semantic reconstruction through three stages: tiled YOLOv11-seg instance segmentation for building footprint extraction; deterministic material classification via hue, saturation, and value (HSV)-based color thresholds; and localized attribute parsing using a quantized vision-language model constrained by domain-specific prompts. translated_title: ArchiveLens：一个用于历史地图语义重建的生成式空间知识框架
translated_abstract: 历史地图包含了关于过去城市环境的密集形态与语义信息，但许多数字化流程主要集中于几何提取，未能捕获诸如建筑用途和建筑材料等制图语义。本研究提出了ArchiveLens，这是一个生成式空间知识框架，可将历史地图转化为以实体为中心、可供机器查询的地理空间数据库。该流程通过三个阶段将形态重建与语义重建解耦：使用分块YOLOv11-seg实例分割进行建筑轮廓提取；通过基于色调、饱和度和明度（HSV）的颜色阈值进行确定性材料分类；以及使用受领域特定提示约束的量化视觉-语言模型进行局部属性解析。提取的实体被整合到一个混合时空检索增强生成（ST-RAG）架构中，该架构结合了密集语义……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ArchiveLens生成式空间知识框架，通过YOLOv11-seg实例分割、HSV颜色阈值材料分类和量化视觉-语言模型属性解析的三阶段流程，将历史地图转化为可机器查询的实体化时空数据库，实现历史城市环境的语义重建。
en_tdlr: ArchiveLens is a generative spatial knowledge framework that transforms historical maps into entity-centric, machine-queryable geospatial databases through a three-stage pipeline (tiled YOLOv11-seg segmentation, HSV-based deterministic material classification, and quantized vision-language model attribute parsing) integrated with a hybrid Spatial-Temporal RAG architecture for semantic reconstruction of historical urban environments.
